title: A Bayesian One-Sample Test for the Mean of Functional Data
summary: In the context of functional data analysis, we propose a Bayesian test to assess whether the mean function of a Gaussian population is identically zero. By leveraging the structure of the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) associated with the covariance function of the underlying process, we approximate the mean by a finite linear combination of kernel sections.
